note.en: the classical Chinese text with Pei Songzhi's commentary

review.en: Chen Shou, born in Shu and later a Jin official, wrote the history of Wei, Shu and Wu in sixty-five spare chapters of biography, without tables or treatises. His restraint left gaps, which Pei Songzhi filled in the fifth century with a commentary quoting more than two hundred other works. Read together they are a lesson in comparing sources, and the ground on which the later novel was built.
review.zh: 陈寿生于蜀，后仕晋，以六十五卷简净的传记写魏、蜀、吴三国，无表无志。他的克制留下空白，五世纪裴松之作注，引书二百余种补之。两者合读，正是一课比勘史料的功夫；后来的小说《三国演义》也建在这片地基上。
